policy.peerDependencies: exact pins required; a range peer requires an approved ADR (R24)
policy.rule: Every external dependency is an exact version recorded here with registry provenance, integrity digest, license, and qualification evidence. Ranges fail with UNPINNED_DEPENDENCY; unrecorded exact versions fail with UNAPPROVED_DEPENDENCY. Promoting a planned entry to approved happens in its owning task with fresh registry evidence.
